news_candidates.title: Adam Posen Thinks Things Could Get 'Messy' for the Fed
news_candidates.title_zh: Adam Posen Thinks Things Could Get 'Messy' for the Fed
news_candidates.summary: Kevin Warsh gave a hawkish speech at this year's annual Kansas City Fed Symposium in Jackson Hole, but that doesn't mean the challenges are over. Will the Fed actually pull the trigger on rate hikes? What happens if the central bank doesn't act quickly enough to curb inflation? And how exactly will the new chair leave his mark on the Fed? We speak with Adam Posen, president of the Peterson Institute for International Economics, who gives us his take on the direction of monetary policy and grades Warsh's speech. We also discuss why high inflation in the US is different than other countries, how the Treasury's wading into the bond market affects Fed independence, which of the Fed task forces might be the most impactful, the "messy jobs" theory of AI, and what Warsh really means when he says he wants the FOMC to have a “good family fight.” See Odd Lots Live in LA September 2026 https://events.bloombergevents.com/event/ODDLOTSLA/summary (Source: Bloomberg)
news_candidates.summary_zh: Kevin Warsh gave a hawkish speech at this year's annual Kansas City Fed Symposium in Jackson Hole, but that doesn't mean the challenges are over. news_candidates.title_zh: 戴森发布售价499美元、配备人工智能和内置摄像头的CameraJet智能牙刷
news_candidates.summary: Dyson Ltd. introduced a $499 toothbrush that uses artificial intelligence and a built-in camera to give real-time feedback, the latest in a growing subset of gadgets that put AI and video in sometimes unconventional places.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 戴森推出一款售价499美元的牙刷，利用人工智能和内置摄像头提供实时反馈。这是越来越多将人工智能和视频置于非传统场景中的小工具之一。

news_candidates.title: Anthropic sued over alleged theft of ‘tens of thousands’ of songs
news_candidates.title_zh: Anthropic遭音乐出版商起诉，索赔涉及数万首歌曲
news_candidates.summary: AI company faces multibillion dollar lawsuit over misuse of copyrighted songs to train Claude models All AI wants for Christmas is a vast back catalogue of songs without paying for it, according to a multibillion-dollar lawsuit against the startup behind the Claude chatbot. Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell, music publishers who manage the copyright of songs on behalf of songwriters and composers, are seeking damages for alleged misuse of “tens of thousands” of copyrighted works by Anthropic. Continue reading...
news_candidates.summary_zh: Sony Music Publishing与Warner Chappell起诉Anthropic，指控其未经授权使用数万首受版权保护的歌曲训练Claude模型，并寻求数十亿美元赔偿。

news_candidates.title: Deere Launches AI Assistant Named JD to Guide Farmers’ Choices
news_candidates.title_zh: 约翰迪尔推出名为JD的人工智能助手，指导农民决策
news_candidates.summary: Farmers are getting some help sorting through the reams of data collected by their high-tech tractors: An AI assistant named JD built into Deere & Co.’s Operations Center mobile application.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 农民将获得帮助，以梳理高科技拖拉机收集的大量数据：约翰迪尔运营中心移动应用内置了名为JD的人工智能助手。

news_candidates.title: Baidu’s AI Profits to Match Those From Search Soon, CFO Says
news_candidates.title_zh: 百度CFO称人工智能业务利润很快将匹敌搜索业务
news_candidates.summary: Baidu Inc.’s finance chief said the company’s investment in AI could soon generate profits and cash payback on par with those of its legacy search business, justifying a hard-fought transition from its internet roots.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 百度财务负责人表示，公司在人工智能领域的投资很快可能产生与传统搜索业务相当的利润和现金回报，从而证明其摆脱互联网根基、艰难转型的合理性。

news_candidates.title: Russian Steel Demand Revives as War Damage Drives Construction
news_candidates.title_zh: 战争损害推动建筑业，俄罗斯钢铁需求复苏
news_candidates.summary: Russian steelmakers are seeing signs of a recovery in domestic demand and prices as delayed construction projects resume and repairs to assets damaged by Ukrainian attacks help drive a revival.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 随着延期的建筑项目恢复，以及修复乌克兰袭击受损资产的工作推动复苏，俄罗斯钢铁企业看到国内需求和价格回升的迹象。

news_candidates.title: Asia Data Center Debt Binge Hitting Banks’ Limits, Barclays Says
news_candidates.title_zh: 巴克莱称亚洲数据中心债务热潮触及银行限度
news_candidates.summary: The billions of dollars being borrowed to fund data centers in Asia are pushing banks to their limits and making them more selective about which projects to finance, according to senior bankers at Barclays Plc.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 巴克莱高级银行家表示，亚洲为数据中心融资而借入的数十亿美元正将银行推向承受能力上限，并使银行对融资项目的选择更加严格。

news_candidates.title: Tehran urges return to June deal, oil prices rise as Trump vows to hit Iran 'hard'
news_candidates.title_zh: 伊朗袭击约旦美军基地，美伊冲突进一步升级
news_candidates.summary: Iran launched an attack on two American bases in Jordan on Monday in retaliation for the U.S. attack on its Larak Island.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 伊朗在美国袭击拉拉克岛后攻击约旦境内两处美军基地。特朗普威胁将对伊朗采取更强硬行动，相关局势已伴随油价上涨。

news_candidates.title: Shein’s Debut Shows the Cost of IPO Missing Its Growth Peak
news_candidates.title_zh: 希音上市首秀显示错过增长高峰的代价
news_candidates.summary: Shein Global Holdings Ltd.’s shares long-awaited market debut has come at an awkward time: the fast-fashion retailer’s peak growth years are behind it just as tariffs, regulatory pressure and intensifying competition are making its next phase harder.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 希音全球控股有限公司期待已久的上市正逢尴尬时机：这家快时尚零售商的高速增长阶段已经过去，而关税、监管压力和竞争加剧正使下一阶段更加艰难。

news_candidates.title: Indian LNG Imports Surge to Six-Year High Even as Prices Spike
news_candidates.title_zh: 即使价格飙升，印度液化天然气进口仍创六年新高
news_candidates.summary: India’s liquefied natural gas imports jumped in August to the highest in nearly six years, defying higher spot prices as fertilizer and fuel distributors sought to replace shipments disrupted by the Iran war.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 印度液化天然气进口量8月跃升至近六年来最高水平，尽管现货价格上涨，化肥和燃料经销商仍寻求替代因伊朗战争中断的货运。

news_candidates.title: India’s Economy Grows Faster Than Expected at 7.8%
news_candidates.title_zh: 印度经济增长7.8%，快于预期
news_candidates.summary: India’s economy grew faster than expected in the last quarter, defying the energy shock from the Iran war. Ruchi Bhatia explains what’s powering the growth and what could come next. (Source: Bloomberg)
news_candidates.summary_zh: 印度经济上季度增长快于预期，顶住了伊朗战争带来的能源冲击。鲁奇·巴蒂亚解释了推动经济增长的因素以及未来可能走势。

news_candidates.title: Indian Prime Minister Modi asks Putin to end Ukraine war amid U.S. tariff threat on Russian oil
news_candidates.title_zh: 印度总理莫迪要求普京结束乌克兰战争，美方威胁对俄油加征关税
news_candidates.summary: Indian PM Narendra Modi has urged Russia to end the Ukraine war and to cease hostilities.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪敦促俄罗斯结束乌克兰战争并停止敌对行动。
